people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

translations.web: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and called there on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.
translations.bsb: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.
translations.kjv: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
translations.asv: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of Jehovah, the Everlasting God.
